fact: Algeria's Ministry of the Interior presentation at the July 2026 EGMRG states the national automated civil registry (RNAEC), created in 2014 and linked to over 3,000 administrations, has since 2018 generated the national ID number automatically at birth registration, giving each newborn a birth act and NIN.
system: Registre national automatisé de l'état civil (RNAEC)

fact: The Algerian Interior Ministry's digitisation of the national civil-status register has digitised more than 100 million marriage, death and birth acts, per La Sentinelle.

The Ministry of the Interior says a computerised civil-status system and a centralised database, the Registre National d'Etat Civil (RNEC), were set up in an operation launched in 2010, with birth-record registers archived digitally.

Interior Minister Said Sayoud says administrations can now consult civil status data directly in the Registre National Automatise de l'Etat Civil, set up under Executive Decree 15-204 of 27 July 2015.
system: Registre National Automatise de l'Etat Civil (RNAEC)
